llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文探讨维生素D与全髋关节置换术后步态恢复的关系，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: Does not contain any biomechanical modeling, stress shielding analysis, contact mechanics, or finite element simulation of hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 探讨维生素D水平与全髋置换术后步态恢复的关系。
summary_zh.method: 前瞻性临床研究，测量术前和术后维生素D水平及步态参数。
summary_zh.result: 较高维生素D水平与更好的步态恢复相关。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the association between vitamin D levels and gait recovery after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A prospective clinical study measuring preoperative and postoperative vitamin D levels and gait parameters.
summary_en.result: Higher vitamin D levels were associated with better gait recovery.
